text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer reaches 9,000 followers. The best part is that these are fans of the real Mejiro Palmer, not the one pretending to be a model student.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling both the joys and hardships of living freely, Mejiro Palmer regains some of the childlike joy of living in the moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her next goal is the Hakodate Kinen. She decides to take a new step forward at this summer G3 race in Hokkaido.
